segments.name: Upstream
segments.description: Explores for and produces crude oil, natural gas, synthetic crude oil and bitumen in Canada for sale to customers.
segments.evidence: Upstream operations include the exploration for, and production of, crude oil, natural gas, synthetic crude oil and bitumen.

segments.name: Downstream
segments.description: Transports and refines crude oil, blends refined products, and distributes and markets them in Canada.
segments.evidence: Downstream operations consist of the transportation and refining of crude oil, blending of refined products and the distribution and marketing of those products.

segments.name: Chemical
segments.evidence: Chemical operations consist of the manufacturing and marketing of various petrochemicals.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for crude oil, natural gas, refined petroleum products and petrochemicals it produces, refines and markets.
revenueModel.evidence: It is active in all phases of the petroleum industry in Canada, including the exploration for, and production and sale of, crude oil and natural gas.
